blocks.content: The user-facing entry point describes the macOS desktop app, its Ollama/llama.cpp/GMLX/MLX LM server options, project and data behavior, security boundaries, and local development/build workflow. It distinguishes loopback model traffic from unsandboxed command/plugin processes, identifies Apache-2.0 licensing for Xtracsys LLC, and points readers to platform guides. Publication remains on hold pending provenance, security, and native-platform checks; read OPEN_SOURCE_READINESS.md for the current release blockers.
Local model inference can operate offline; plugins and approved commands are not network sandboxed.
The README roadmap lists outstanding work only; use OPEN_SOURCE_READINESS.md for current publication blockers and risk scope.
